issues.title: Wildcard fallback silently redirects to /overview instead of displaying dedicated 404 Route Not Found page
steps_to_reproduce: 2. Navigate in address bar directly to http://localhost:5173/non-existent-route
3. Observe browser URL changes silently to http://localhost:5173/overview
issues.expected_behavior: Display an informative 404 Route Not Found screen or toast banner with a clear navigation link back to Overview.
issues.actual_behavior: React Router wildcard matches <Route path='*' element={<Navigate to='/overview' replace />} /> without operator feedback.
issues.root_cause: The router configuration lacks a dedicated NotFoundPage component and falls back unconditionally to Navigate replace='/overview'.
evidence: apps/dashboard/src/App.tsx line 56: <Route path='*' element={<Navigate to='/overview' replace />} />
issues.proposed_fix: Create a dedicated NotFoundPage component with quick links to dashboard modules and render it on path='*'.
issues.verification_test: Navigate to /invalid-url and assert 'Page Not Found' heading with 'Return to Control Tower' button appears.

issues.title: Warehouse 2D Viewer layout canvas lacks interactive mouse drag-to-pan gesture
steps_to_reproduce: 2. Locate the 2D SVG warehouse layout canvas
3. Click and drag the mouse pointer across the aisles to pan
issues.expected_behavior: Canvas should smoothly drag-pan across coordinate space to inspect dense rack clusters.
issues.actual_behavior: Canvas uses a static viewBox computed from layout dimensions without mouse drag event listeners.
issues.root_cause: Warehouse2DViewer does not attach onMouseDown/onMouseMove/onMouseUp listeners to dynamically adjust SVG viewBox offsets during drag gestures.
issues.proposed_fix: Add panOffset state with mouse/touch drag handlers on the SVG container to support smooth pan and zoom interactions.
issues.verification_test: Simulate mouse drag on canvas and assert viewBox attributes update with mouse translation.

issues.title: Optimization Service container logs harmless SwigPyObject deprecation warnings during OR-Tools initialization
steps_to_reproduce: 1. Run optimization service tests or initialize OR-Tools routing solver
issues.actual_behavior: DeprecationWarning: builtin type SwigPyPacked has no __module__ attribute logged during SWIG wrapper import.
issues.root_cause: OR-Tools Python C++ SWIG bindings produce deprecation warnings in Python 3.9+ when importing C extension types.
issues.proposed_fix: Add warnings.filterwarnings('ignore', category=DeprecationWarning, module='ortools.*') or pytest filterwarnings in setup.
issues.verification_test: Execute pytest and verify zero warnings logged.

issues.title: Global store selector does not synchronize with URL query params or localStorage across full page reloads
steps_to_reproduce: 2. Select a specific dark store in the topbar dropdown (e.g., 'store_nyc_02')
issues.expected_behavior: Selected store ID should persist across page reloads via URL query param (?store_id=...) or localStorage.
issues.actual_behavior: Selected store resets to empty string ('All Dark Stores') upon full reload because state is only stored in memory in App.tsx.
issues.root_cause: selectedStoreId state in App.tsx is initialized to '' without reading from useSearchParams or localStorage.
issues.proposed_fix: Initialize selectedStoreId from URL search params with fallback to localStorage.
issues.verification_test: Select store, reload page, assert selected store remains active in topbar and table filters.
